contests.title: Wyandot County — Mental health and addiction services levy renewal

provenance.quote:
A renewal of a tax for the benefit of Wyandot County for the
purpose of providing for the operation of community addiction
services providers and community mental health services providers
and the acquisition, construction, renovation, financing,
maintenance, and operation of alcohol and drug addiction facilities
and mental health facilities by the Mental Health and Recovery
Services Board of Seneca, Sandusky and Wyandot Counties, that
the county auditor estimates will collect $361,454 annually, at a
rate not exceeding 0.6 mills for each $1 of taxable value, which
amounts to $13 for each $100,000 of the county auditor’s market
value, for 10 years commencing in 2027, first due in calendar year
2028.

contests.title: Wyandot County — Sales and use tax continuation

provenance.quote:
The Board of County Commissioners of Wyandot County proposes
a continuation of a sales and use tax in the amount of 0.5% for the
purpose of providing additional revenue for the County’s general
fund for the operation of the Wyandot County Sheriff’s Department
and Emergency Medical Services for a period of 5 years.
Shall the resolution of the Wyandot county commissioners
proposing a 0.5% sales and use tax be approved?

contests.title: Wynford Local School District — Additional earned-income tax

provenance.quote:
Shall an annual income tax of 1.74 percent on the earned income
of individuals residing in the school district be imposed by the
Wynford Local School District for 10 years, beginning January 1,
2027, for the purposes of current expenses?

contests.title: Ridgedale Local School District — Current-expense levy renewal

provenance.quote:
Shall a fixed-sum levy renewing an existing levy be imposed by the
Ridgedale Local School District for the purposed of paying current
expenses of the district in the sum of $575,034 and a levy of taxes
to be made outside of the ten-mill limitation estimated by the county
auditor to average 2.44 mills for each $1 of taxable value, which
amounts to $85 for each $100,000 of the county auditor’s market
value, for a period of 5 years, commencing in 2027, first due in
calendar year 2028?
The county auditor has certified that the amount by which the carry-
over balance in the district’s general operating budget from the
preceding fiscal year exceeds the district’s general fund
expenditures made in the preceding fiscal year is $0, which is 0%
of those expenditures.

measureRecords.noMeans: Do not renew this levy through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a property-tax levy for township current expenses for five years, commencing in 2026 and first due in 2027. The rate is capped at 2 mills per dollar of taxable value; the auditor estimates $19,124 annually and $26 per $100,000 of market value.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not renew this levy through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a property-tax levy for township current expenses for five years, commencing in 2027 and first due in 2028. The rate is capped at 1 mill per dollar of taxable value; the auditor estimates $22,088 annually and $19 per $100,000 of market value.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not renew this levy through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a property-tax levy supporting community mental health and addiction services and facilities operated through the Seneca, Sandusky and Wyandot Counties services board for ten years, commencing 2027 and first due 2028. The cap is 0.6 mills per dollar of taxable value; the auditor estimates $361,454 annually and $13 per $100,000 of market value.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Renew this ten-year mental health and addiction services levy.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not renew this levy through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Continues a 0.5% county sales and use tax for five years to support operation of the Sheriff’s Department and Emergency Medical Services through the county general fund.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Continue the 0.5% sales and use tax for five years.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not approve this tax continuation through this question.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Adds a 1.74% annual tax on earned income of individuals residing in Wynford Local School District for current school expenses for ten years beginning January 1, 2027.
measureRecords.noMeans: Do not impose this additional income tax.

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Renews a fixed-sum property-tax levy of $575,034 outside the ten-mill limitation for current school expenses for five years, commencing 2027 and first due 2028. The auditor estimates an average 2.44 mills per dollar of taxable value, or $85 per $100,000 of market value. The certified carry-over excess is $0.
